en: The image shows a historical colorized view of a busy port city with various ships and boats in a wide harbor area. In the foreground, there are densely packed historic buildings and a mosque with a tall minaret. The upper part of the image has two old stamps bearing the Ottoman crescent and star, with postmarks in Arabic script. In the distant background is a green, elevated area with more buildings and domes, perhaps palace-like structures.
